results.question: Use the Linen Shirt then, all colours.
results.sql: SELECT to_char(o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney', 'YYYY-MM') AS month, sum(l.quantity) AS units_sold, round(sum(l.unit_price * l.quantity - l.line_discount)::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_lines l ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN variants v ON l.variant_id = v.variant_id JOIN products p ON v.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' AND p.title = 'Linen Shirt' AND o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney' >= timestamp '2026-09-30' - interval '3 months' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
results.assumptions: Interpreting as: How have sales of the Linen Shirt (all colours) changed over the last 3 months? (Date range: 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30 based on 2026-09-30 being today). Revenue is gross (order_lines unit_price * quantity - line_discount) for non-voided orders.
results.answer: Over the last three months, sales for the Linen Shirt across all colours peaked in August before dipping in September. You sold 33 units for $3,278.35 in August, compared to 25 units for $2,418.79 in July and 24 units for $2,338.84 in September. These figures show gross revenue from non-voided orders and do not account for any returns or refunds.
